cues: The costs: no internet, no service.
Your data may physically sit in another country, under its laws.
Vendor lock in makes leaving expensive.
And when the provider goes down, so do you.
As of twenty twenty five, Amazon held about thirty per cent of the market, Microsoft twenty two and Google twelve.
